title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

description:

Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. Job Summary

This position is on the team building StrongDM, now part of Delineaâthe universal access management platform that secures and audits access to databases, servers, Kubernetes clusters, and web applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will apply deep expertise across distributed systems, security, and cloud architecture to help shape the technical direction of StrongDMâs proxy and control-plane platform. You will take on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous engineering challenges, exercise independent judgment on architecture and design decisions that span multiple teams, and serve as a recognized subject matter expert on secure, high-scale distributed systems written in Go. You will report to the teamâs engineering manager.

What Youâll Do:

  • Lead the architecture and technical direction of highly concurrent, distributed backend systems in Go (Golang), setting engineering standards that extend across multiple teams within StrongDM and Delinea.

  • Drive design decisions for the proxy data plane (gateways and relays) and control-plane services, evaluating tradeoffs on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous technical problems.

  • Partner with architects, product managers, and DevOps/SRE leadership to shape multi-quarter system roadmaps, translating broader business priorities into concrete technical strategy.

  • Lead code and design reviews across teams, holding a high bar for performance, security, and maintainability, and coach engineers on applying that bar independently.

  • Demonstrated experience architecting highly concurrent, distributed systems and exercising independent judgment on methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, including Goâs standard networking and cryptography libraries.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, network protocols, and API design (gRPC/Protobuf and/or RESTful APIs), with the ability to reason about tradeoffs across an entire system.

  • Experience with AWS (or another major cloud provider) and cloud-native deployment models at production scale.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to convey advanced technical concepts and persuade diverse stakeholders and audiences.

  • Proven ability to build formal working relationships and coordinate across multiple teams and functions.

  • Conceptual thinking skills sufficient to understand advanced technical issues and their broader implications for the business.

  • Demonstrated track record mentoring engineers and being recognized as a subject matter expert others turn to for guidance.

Weâd Love to See:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) beyond a single provider.

  • Experience establishing or influencing engineering-wide standards for Terraform automation and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Deep expertise with secure protocols, mTLS and PKI, secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), and credential brokering.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Employment Information

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Reasonable Accommodations

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Background Checks

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

At-Will Employment

Employment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

Meet The Guru

Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track.

â­ï¸ The role

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets.

This is a great role for someone with some experience in SaaS or online customer support who wants to keep developing their technical, communication and customer-facing skills in a friendly, remote-first team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Learning Resource Guru inside out

  • In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer.

Responding to customer questions

  • Help customers with day-to-day support questions, including product usage, account setup, billing enquiries, troubleshooting and general "how do Iâ¦?" queries.
  • Most support is handled by email, though you may occasionally join a phone or video call when that would help resolve something more quickly.

Troubleshooting problems

  • Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes.

Working with the wider team

  • Work closely with Dana and the wider Resource Guru team to understand customer questions, resolve issues, and make sure useful feedback is shared with Product and Engineering.
  • Help create clear internal reports when customers report bugs or technical issues, and tag/categorise feature feedback so the team understands what customers need.

Improving our help content

  • Help keep the Help Centre useful and up to date - updating existing articles, writing new ones, recording simple walkthroughs, or suggesting improvements when you notice customers asking the same questions repeatedly.

Using our support tools

  • Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

Helping customers feel looked after

  • Using support tools such as Front, Intercom, Zendesk, HubSpot or similar

Working Hours

The exact working pattern will depend on your location and the coverage we agree, but you should be clear in your application about where youâre based and what working hours you would expect to keep.

Job Snapshot

Location: Remote - California (San Diego or Southern California Preferred)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $28-30 per hour

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Environment: Remote

Reports To: Human Resources Manager

About Pacific Health Group

At Pacific Health Group, we care deeply about the people and communities we serve. We meet individuals with kindness, respect, and understandingâlistening first, honoring each person's journey, and offering support without judgment.

Through compassionate, person-centered healthcare, behavioral health services, and social supports, we walk alongside people as they work toward healing, stability, and a healthier, more hopeful life.

Our Core Values

  • Speak with integrityâclear, respectful, and honest in every interaction
  • Embrace innovation, trying new ideas, learning fast, and improving care.
  • Own our roles, staying accountable for outcomes and documenting accurately
  • Build genuine connections with members, families, and teammates through empathy and cultural sensitivity
  • Lead with trust by being consistent, transparent, and following through
  • Celebrate wins together, recognizing individual and team achievements
  • Collaborate with purpose, partnering across departments and with community providers to solve problems
  • Ask for support and offer support, because thriving together is how we serve our members best

Role Overview & Impact

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Coordination

  • Support candidate communications using approved templates
  • Track candidate status and documentation in the applicant tracking system
  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)

title: Product Design Manager
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We're looking for an experienced design manager to lead our Product Design team.

This is a management role. Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust.

You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.

More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it.

🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves:


Lead and develop the team

  • Run regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels.

  • Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be.

  • Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design.

  • Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team.

Raise the design bar

  • Set and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft.

  • Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them.

  • Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.

Own the whole product experience

  • Keep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns.

  • Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature.

Make design a real partner

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution.

  • Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority.

  • Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down.

How much of this is hands-on?

Worth being direct, because it's the question every good candidate asks. This is a management role: developing designers, raising the bar, and making design count in product decisions is the job, and that's where your time goes.

You'll stay close to the craft in critiques, in reviews and in the detail of the work, and you'll occasionally pick up design work yourself. When that happens it sits outside the squads and varies with the period: an exploratory concept, a gap during someone's leave, a problem that needs a first pass. It is not a 50/50 split, and if what you want is to keep a squad's worth of delivery alongside managing the team, this isn't the role.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 👥 Proven design management: You've managed product designers in a product-led technology company for 3+ years, with a team of five or more. This is not a first management role.

  • 🧭 Running a team well: You've run effective 1:1s, evidence-based performance reviews and difficult feedback conversations, including with people who weren't performing. You've built or improved a career progression framework for designers, and you're comfortable with the administrative side of managing a team rather than treating it as overhead.

  • 📈 Growing people: You coach and mentor, you run critique that changes the work, and you can point to specific designers who got measurably better or grew in scope while reporting to you.

  • 🎨 Design taste and judgment: Your own craft is strong enough that designers trust your read on quality, you can articulate what separates adequate design from excellent design, and you'll step into the work directly when the situation calls for it.

  • 🎯 Hiring: You've hired designers consistently well, you know where good design talent is and how to attract it, and you can tell the difference quickly.

  • 🤖 AI fluency: You use AI tools hands-on in your own work and in how your team designs, and you have an informed view on designing AI-enabled products. AI agents are the product here, so this one is not optional.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical products: You've managed design teams in B2B SaaS, developer tools, workflow automation or similarly technical products.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You don't need to write code, but genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath (APIs, webhooks, data structures, how workflows actually execute) earns you credibility with engineers here.

  • 👩‍💻 Designing for developers: You've designed products for developers, technical operators or other sophisticated users.

  • 🔭 Systems view: You can step back from individual projects to spot patterns and UX problems across a broader product experience.

  • 🤝 Influence without authority: You bring Product and Engineering peers with you through reasoning rather than positional authority.

  • 📊 Scaling teams: You've grown a design team through a period of rapid company growth.

  • 🌍 Distributed teams: You've managed designers in remote-first or highly distributed organisations.

  • 🔓 Open source: You've worked on open-source or community-driven products.

  • 🌱 Inclusive hiring: You've meaningfully broadened the diversity of a design team through how you hire.

Our hiring process

We'll tell you the whole shape of it upfront, and there's very little homework.

  1. Screening call with our recruiter. 45 minutes, no prep.

  2. Leading designers with the hiring manager, 75 minutes. You'll present for 20 minutes on a team you built, grew or turned around. Reuse existing material; it shouldn't take more than two or three hours. We don't need case studies of your own design work.

  3. Live critique and coaching, 60 minutes. We'll send you a real piece of n8n design work 24 hours ahead. You'll critique it, then have a coaching conversation with the designer who made it. No preparation beyond reading it and trying the product.

  4. Conversation with our VP of Product, and a culture call with Jan, our CEO. 45 minutes each, same day where we can.

  5. Meet two or three of the designers you'd be managing. Not scored; it's for you as much as for us.

We'll also ask for two references, one of them a former direct report. A portfolio is welcome if you have one, though we know not every design manager keeps theirs current.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead design for a product that hundreds of thousands of builders use to automate real work, sitting right where developer tools, AI agents and no-code interaction models meet. The design problems are genuinely hard and largely unsolved.

You're inheriting an established team with strong designers, not building from zero, and there's real room to shape how the team coaches, critiques, grows and works with Product and Engineering, rather than inheriting a rigid design organisation. You'll stay close enough to the craft to influence quality directly, while your main job is making the designers around you better.

You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, at the point where n8n is scaling from a beloved open-source project into a major B2B platform. Design's contribution to product thinking is established here, and has a long way still to run.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

description:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Munich or Frankfurt).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.
  • Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot.
  • Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles.
  • Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript.
  • Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them.
  • Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training.


Why us?

You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard.

Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA.

Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners.

Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly.

Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program.


Benefits

  • Subsidised EGYM Wellpass

These are the recruiting steps that await you:

  1. Culture Fit - Get to know Rike or Kim from our People team. Learn more about nonplusultra and our culture.

  3. Case Study - Work through a practical training scenario together with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.

title: Management Accountant
description:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

We're seeking a bilingual Management Accountant to serve as the cornerstone of our German accounting operations. This role combines hands-on accounting execution with strategic financial operations, ensuring seamless coordination between our German and US entities while maintaining compliance with both German and US GAAP standards.

You'll work at the intersection of day-to-day financial operations and cross-border business requirements, partnering closely with our Head of Finance, People Operations, external payroll providers, and local German accounting advisors to maintain accurate, timely financial reporting across our dual-entity structure.

What You’ll Work On

Core Accounting Operations

  • Manage full-cycle billing, collections, and accounts payable for German entity

  • Execute treasury and cash management functions, including inter-company settlements

  • Process and reconcile inter-company transactions between German and US entities

  • Partner with People Operations and external payroll agencies across Europe to ensure accurate and timely payroll accounting entries

  • Review payroll outputs from external providers and post journal entries to the general ledger

  • Reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts (accruals, statutory deductions, benefits) each month

  • Maintain accurate books and records in accordance with German GAAP (HGB)

  • Maintain dual bookkeeping across DATEV (German statutory books) and Rillet (global ERP), ensuring both systems remain accurate, aligned, and reconciled on an ongoing basis

Tax & Compliance

  • Coordinate with external German accountants (Steuerberater) to ensure accurate VAT returns and filings

  • Support annual tax compliance including Körperschaftsteuer and Gewerbesteuer

  • Maintain documentation for tax audits and statutory requirements

  • Monitor regulatory changes affecting German accounting and tax obligations

US GAAP Reporting Support

  • Assist in reconciling German GAAP accounts to US GAAP basis

  • Provide monthly financial data and schedules for consolidated US GAAP reporting

  • Support quarter-end and year-end close processes for global consolidation

  • Help maintain documentation for US GAAP accounting policies and procedures

Process & Systems

  • Implement and improve accounting processes and internal controls

  • Work with ERP and financial systems to enhance efficiency and accuracy

  • Support integration of German operations into global financial infrastructure

  • Maintain organized documentation for internal and external stakeholders

What We’re Looking For:

  • Education: Completed Ausbildung as Steuerfachangestellter/ Steuerfachwirt or similar accounting qualification; Bachelor's degree in Finance/Accounting preferred

  • Experience: 3 plus years experience in accounting role(s), preferably in fast-growing companies or startups

  • Language: Full fluency in both German and English is a core requirement

  • Technical: Strong proficiency with accounting software and Excel; experience with ERP systems

  • Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Freiburg, Germany

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with DATEV and/or modern cloud ERP systems (e.g., Rillet, NetSuite)

  • Familiarity with both German GAAP (HGB) and US GAAP principles

  • Experience working in dual-entity or international company structures

  • Prior work with German Steuerberater and understanding of VAT compliance

  • Experience coordinating with People Operations and third-party payroll providers (rather than running payroll directly)

  • Experience in technology or SaaS companies

  • Knowledge of intercompany accounting and transfer pricing basics

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Base Annual Salary: EU €70,000- €100,000 + Equity

Note: Our recruitment process uses AI-assisted tools to help manage and organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

description:

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

Project Management:

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About TACTILIA:

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role:

As Business Development Manager, you will own TACTILIA's commercial launch: finding the right customers, opening doors, and turning early interest into signed deals. You'll sell a technically demanding product to engineering and business decision-makers in robotics and industrial automation, and you'll help define which markets and partnerships we pursue first. Your feedback from the field will directly shape our product roadmap and go-to-market.

What you will do:

  • Identify, prioritize, and win target accounts across robotics OEMs, system integrators, and industrial end users

  • Own the full sales cycle, from first contact and qualification through technical evaluation, proposal, negotiation, and close

  • Build relationships with decision-makers on both the technical side (R&D, engineering leads) and the commercial side (management, procurement)

  • Develop strategic partnerships with ecosystem players, and leverage SCHUNK's industrial network where it opens doors

  • Translate customer requirements into clear value propositions, working closely with our engineering team

  • Bring structured market and customer insight back to the team to inform pricing, positioning, and product priorities


What you bring:

  • 5+ years in business development or B2B sales, ideally selling technical products or solutions to industrial or engineering customers

  • A track record of winning new accounts and closing complex deals with long sales cycles

  • Confidence discussing technical products credibly with engineers, without needing to be an engineer yourself

  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust at both the engineering and executive level

  • Ownership mentality: you're comfortable building structure and pipeline without a ready-made playbook

  • Fluent English; German is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience in robotics, automation, mechatronics, or industrial hardware industries

  • Existing network among robotics companies, integrators, or industrial automation buyers

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up where you helped build the sales function

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer, Learner App (m/f/d)
description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

Berlitz has taught languages for almost 150 years, mostly in classrooms and with live teachers. Now we're putting that method in people's pockets. The Berlitz app connects structured lessons, AI speaking and writing practice, 1:1 sessions with human tutors, and visible progress into one learning loop on iOS and Android. We're launching it market by market, and growing it fast.

Our learners are professionals who need a language for their career. Some pay for themselves. Others get Berlitz through their employer, who wants proof the investment is working. Both need an app they open every day because it helps them, and keep paying for because they can see themselves getting better.

As Senior Product Designer, you'll own major parts of the learner app, from the first minute after download to the moment someone books their tenth tutor session. You'll report to the Staff Product Designer for this area of the business, and partner as an equal with Product Management, Engineering, and our AI and learning experience teams.

What you'll be doing

  • Design core learner journeys end to end across iOS and Android: onboarding and placement, daily learning, AI practice, tutor booking, progress, and the path from free to paid.

  • Design for habit and momentum. Find out why learners come back, why they drop off, and what makes them feel progress, then build that into the product.

  • Shape how learners speak and write with AI: conversational interfaces, real-time feedback on pronunciation and writing, and the moments where an AI tutor should hand over to a human one.

  • Work AI-native every day. Use AI design tools and agentic workflows to explore, prototype, and produce at speed, while staying the human in the loop who decides what's good enough to ship.

  • Pressure-test every PRD before it becomes a design. Question the assumptions, find the missing edge cases, and sharpen the problem with your PM, instead of passing a brief straight to a tool and accepting what comes back.

  • Hold AI output to a high bar. Run rigorous evals on what AI produces for craft, accessibility, localisation, and brand fit. When you see the same problem twice, fix it at the source by updating the design system.

  • Run research yourself. Talk to learners often, run usability tests, read the analytics, and set up experiments that tell us whether a change worked.

  • Own the conversion and retention moments (trials, paywalls, upgrade prompts, reminders) so they earn revenue without costing the learner's trust.

  • Design for corporate learners too: employer-paid access, entitlements, and the progress their company expects to see, without making the app feel corporate.

  • Build with Berlitz's shared design system and help it evolve, especially the mobile patterns, motion, and micro-interactions a daily-use app needs. Keep it structured so that both people and AI tools use it correctly.

  • Design for many markets and languages from the start, including text expansion, right-to-left scripts, and accessibility.

  • Work closely with engineers to ship fast, then sweat the details once it's live.

What we're looking for

  • Several years designing and shipping consumer mobile apps that people use every day, with a portfolio that shows native iOS and Android craft.

  • Evidence that your design work moved retention, engagement, or conversion, and a clear view of how you measured it.

  • Strong interaction and visual design. You care how a screen feels in the hand: motion, feedback, and pacing, as well as how it looks.

  • Hands-on research and experimentation. You've run your own interviews and usability tests, and used A/B tests and analytics to make calls.

  • An understanding of B2B: how a product changes when the person paying isn't the person using it, and how to serve both.

  • Real experience with AI design tools (currently we mostly use Claude Design) and agentic workflows. You use tools like Claude Design, Figma Make, or Paper, and AI coding tools like Claude Code daily, and you can show examples where you rejected or reworked an AI output and explain why.

  • Experience working within a design system and extending it.

  • Clear communication, and the confidence to push back on PMs, engineers, and senior stakeholders with reasoning they can act on.

  • Fluent English. Another language is a plus. We are a language company, after all.

  • Based in Germany, Switzerland, or Hungary.

Nice to have

  • A background in a learning, language, or content app, or another product built on a daily habit (reading, audio, fitness).

  • Experience with freemium and subscription models, including app store payment flows.

  • Experience designing for markets in Latin America or South Asia.

  • Experience taking work from AI design tools to code to the repo. That means pushing front-end changes yourself through pull requests and checking your work in iOS and Android simulators.

What we offer

  • A product that changes careers. Our learners need the language for a job, a promotion, or a move abroad. Your work helps them get there.

  • Real ownership, early. Large parts of the learner app are yours to shape while the product is still young.

  • A combination few learning apps have. A recognized learning method, a global network of human teachers, and an AI team building practice and tutoring on top.

  • One global Berlitz. Join a company actively rebuilding itself, with new products, new systems, and new ways of working across every team.

  • Remote-first flexibility, based in Germany, Switzerland, Hungary, or Netherlands.

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.
